title: Record Loss Sets a Rare-Trajectory Limit on Quantum Purification
summary: Continuous quantum feedback uses time-resolved measurement records to steer monitored systems toward pure states. Yet how the information available to a controller determines the ultimate purification speed remains unresolved. We establish this relation for a qubit under fixed-spectrum Hermitian monitoring with detector loss, obtaining the exact long-time impurity-moment spectrum optimized over causal basis controls at each horizon.
